provenance: Built by static reading of the C# catalog sources with extract.py; nothing was run against a host. Compare with the live tools/list of the pinned build (needs local test).

start_options.--read-only: hides Write, Destructive and Code tools (Visible())
start_options.--enable-script / SASAAH_CSI_ENABLE_SCRI: csi_run_script is opt-in; DisableScript defaults to true (CsiServerConfig.cs:14)
start_options.--allow-attached-writes: allows deletes and mutating invokes on attached/bridge targets
start_options.--script-timeout-sec: default 120, parsed but not wired to the engine
start_options.--audit-log: JSONL audit of Write/Destructive/Code calls (CsiAuditJournal); default %LOCALAPPDATA%/Sasaah/csi-mcp-audit.jsonl

server.version_reporting: No server version, build id or tool-list hash is reported: Program.cs sets no ServerInfo, csi_status has no version field, and Directory.Build.props pins Version 0.1.0 for every build.
